# arin_rpki_setup_request (Data Source)

Generate a local RFC 8183 child or publisher setup request from an existing BPKI CA certificate. The corresponding private key must remain with the CA software. This data source produces XML for an out-of-band exchange; it does not submit the request or enroll the organization. No API key is needed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "arin_rpki_setup_request" "child" {
  message_type = "child_request"
  handle       = "example-child"
  bpki_ta_pem  = file("${path.module}/bpki-ca.pem")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bpki_ta_pem` (String) Exactly one self-signed BPKI CA certificate in PEM form. CA properties and self-signature are checked; RPKI resource extensions are forbidden. Current validity dates and possession of its private key are not checked. Supply only the public certificate.
- `handle` (String) Requested child or publisher handle, up to 255 ASCII letters, digits, slashes, underscores or hyphens. The service may assign a different handle in its response.
- `message_type` (String) child_request for delegated provisioning or publisher_request for repository publication.

### Optional

- `referrals` (Attributes List) Ordered publication referrals, allowed only for publisher_request. Copy referrer and authorization_base64 from a trusted parent response. Tokens are base64-validated but their CMS signatures are not verified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--referrals))
- `tag` (String) Optional exchange tag, up to 1024 characters after XML token whitespace normalization. Omission and an explicitly empty tag remain distinct in generated XML.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) SHA-256 of the generated XML bytes.
- `xml` (String, Sensitive) Deterministic generated XML, bounded to 4 MiB. It includes referral tokens when supplied and is stored in Terraform state.

<a id="nestedatt--referrals"></a>
### Nested Schema for `referrals`

Required:

- `authorization_base64` (String, Sensitive) Opaque referral CMS token from the parent, up to 512,000 decoded bytes.
- `referrer` (String) Referring publisher handle.
